notes: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE. ORCHESTRA-7 is not a real system. Every value and source below is invented to demonstrate ACL-1.0. No claim is made about any real product. Do not cite as a real audit.

sources.title: ORCHESTRA-7 Tool Orchestration Config, published repo (fictional)

C1.basis: System card calls it a 'unified model' but a routing description presents ensemble routing as single-model generality — disqualifier; capped at Claimed.

C2.basis: Independent reproduction: information from one session alters behavior in a later separate session without re-supply; holds across repetition.

C3.basis: Tool composition reproducible from published config, but a human selects the tool and the system fills arguments (B-02).

C4.basis: Independent testing shows stateless request-response; no environment whose state the system's own prior actions changed, despite marketing.

C5.basis: Disclosure describes training-time feedback presented as runtime adaptation — disqualifier; no measured runtime effect shown.

C6.basis: 'Multi-agent' is one model prompted in sequence with role labels; no conflict-resolution mechanism (B-03). Demo video only.

C7.basis: Permission boundary enforced at the execution layer for high-risk actions (reproducible from disclosed config) but advisory-only for the rest.

C8.basis: Vendor states an 'independent verifier' but it is closed; independence from the generator cannot be tested (B-06, access-limited).

boundary_cases.reasoning: B-02: human selects the tool; system fills arguments. Selection is the audited capability, so capped at Partial.
B-03: role-labeled sequential calls to one model with no conflict-resolution path. Role labels are not coordination; resolved to Claimed.
B-06: verifier is closed; independence cannot be confirmed. Recorded as Claimed with access-limit note, never Absent.

access_limits.note: Internal composition not inspectable; ensemble-vs-unified rests on a secondary description (S-05), not direct inspection.
Verifier is a closed component; could not test independence from the generator or repeatability of verification.
